name: Wenchang LC-201
best_known_for: Long March 7 pad on Hainan: all ten Tianzhou cargo ships to Tiangong, plus Long March 8 flights
credit: Launch Complex 201 is the second of three pads at the Wenchang Space Launch Site on Hainan, built for the Long March 7 and also used by the Long March 7A and Long March 8. The first launch from the site, and from this pad, was the Long March 7 maiden flight on 25 June 2016 (12:00 UTC) with the Yuanzheng-1A upper stage. All ten Tianzhou cargo ships to the Tiangong station launched from LC-201, from Tianzhou 1 on 20 April 2017 to Tianzhou 10 on 11 May 2026. Sources: Wikipedia (Wenchang Space Launch Site, Long March 7, Tianzhou), Astronautix, SpacePolicyOnline; coordinates from Wikipedia.
